description: This file defines warning reporting categories as classes with serialization, deserialization, and string conversion methods. It includes specific warning classes such as TooLongWaitingForLock, SinkStillHasReference, TooLongInvokeRPC, and others, each representing different warning types with associated bounds and formatting logic.

classes.name: TooLongWaitingForLock
classes.description: Represents a warning for long wait times to acquire a lock.

classes.name: SinkStillHasReference
classes.description: Represents a warning when a sink still holds a reference during destruction.

classes.name: TooLongInvokeRPC
classes.description: Represents a warning for RPC calls that take too long.

classes.name: JobTooLongToFinish
classes.description: Represents a warning for jobs that take too long to complete.

classes.name: JobTooLongWaitingInQueue
classes.description: Represents a warning for jobs waiting too long in the queue.

classes.name: TooLongDecrypt
classes.description: Represents a warning for decryption operations that take too long.

classes.name: JobActiveForTooLong
classes.description: Represents a warning for jobs active for too long, indicating potential deadlocks.

methods.name: Serialize
methods.description: Serializes the object into a byte buffer.

methods.name: Deserialize
methods.description: Deserializes the object from a byte buffer.

methods.name: ToString
methods.description: Converts the warning object into a human-readable string.

methods.name: Analyze
methods.description: Analyzes interface and method IDs for RPC warning.
